spatial_flow_description: Build a left-to-right decision diagram. On the left put “任务证据” with three compact rows “请求语义”, “工具集合”, “既往失败”. It feeds the central upper box “有限探测”, containing “候选层位” and “候选低秩容量”. A separate small dashed box above it reads “冻结主干”, connected by a short line to the probe stage. A downward arrow reaches central lower “收益与干扰”, with “新任务增益” and “历史开发集损失”. Fan out from this scoring stage into a vertical stack of four alternative decision boxes at the right, labelled exactly “复用”, “更新”, “冻结”, “替换”. These are mutually selectable alternatives, not four sequential operations. Merge their outgoing paths into a broad bottom box “当前策略”, with “版本｜容量｜实际成本”. Beneath it, a compact outlined resource strip has title “总预算内选择” and text “探测成本计入”. Keep the branching and joining lines clear and avoid intersections through labels.
caption_note: 路线一：依据任务与历史开发证据，在累计容量和计算预算内选择复用、更新、冻结或替换。有限探测计入总成本，历史测试结果不参与决策。
No measurements or pre-experiment results are rendered.
RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: White canvas and WHITE box fills with COLORED BORDERS ONLY.
At most three blue chromatic colors plus neutrals.
Native structural rectangles, dividers and connectors only; every main block has a geometric anchor.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning decorative symbols, NO 3D rendering.
Dashed borders for frozen modules; dashed arrows for feedback or unverified mechanism.
No overall title, invented formulas, dimensions or performance numbers.
Readable simplified Chinese, no cropping or overlapping labels.
